The meaning of Aurora

Aurora is the Roman goddess of sunrise, whose tears turned into morning dew. She was said to renew herself each day, traveling across the sky to announce the sun’s arrival. Buying this piece brings dawn. Wearing it is a symbol of new beginnings.

A Personal Note from Candice King, Founder of Zaytun

I was afraid of becoming a mother. I thought I wouldn’t be capable of putting someone else first. But the moment I met Aurora and she latched, everything changed. She brought a brightness into my life I didn’t know was missing.

Aurora taught me to love fully — not only her, but other children too. She reminds me every day what truly matters: love multiplies. She inspires every step I take to make life better for others.

I am not me without her.
